artifact.captureLocation: conversation-local transient media, not published or attached to GitHub

feedback.origin: Qualitative founder reaction to the produced specimen; director's observations derived from contact sheet and locally stored encoded frames
feedback.interpretation: Technically assembled motion graphics with repetitive UI-card framing, not a compelling film; no evidence of earned emotional connection

findings.evidence: Central subject in three beats is the same stylized browser skeleton, with no actual customer, workflow, object or place.
findings.requiredChange: Acquire rights-clear story assets or verified product captures and place an identifiable object, person, or real process in the first second.

findings.evidence: Encoded frames 30/90/162 repeat the browser-centered composition and text-led layouts.
findings.requiredChange: Rebuild from a real shot list with close-up physical details, establishing scale, purposeful camera movement and distinct compositions.

findings.evidence: Prototype technical audit counted 6.875 seconds of frozen footage, 57.3% of a 12-second video.
findings.requiredChange: Animate scene-state changes that advance the story; allow purposeful holds but reject unrelated decorative animation.

findings.evidence: Music is a procedural bed rather than original thematic scoring tied to meaningful on-screen events.
findings.requiredChange: Create and audition an original cue with separate stems; synchronize phrase resolution with the visible turning point and preserve intentional silence.

findings.evidence: No genuine character reaction, lived stakes, or observed transformation appears in the film.
findings.requiredChange: Show a credible person or physical scenario with understandable stakes, and only claim an outcome that the footage or application proves.

findings.evidence: Mock browser illustration is visually similar to a template and cannot establish real product operation.
findings.requiredChange: Use live-captured software truth or clearly staged physical scenes, provenance labels and exact-frame visual observation.

next: Retain as a negative benchmark. Do not recycle its layouts, score it as a Creative Council winner, or publish it. Follow the physical-story-first production brief.
